consults: the capability catalogue this node resolves to
the integrations configured for this team
stages.name: resolve_integrations
stages.summary: Works out what this team can actually call, and ends the run early when the answer is nothing.

consults: the alert as it arrived, with whatever the adapter already parsed
recent investigations, to recognise a duplicate
stages.name: intake
stages.summary: Decides whether there is an incident at all, and links it to one already open when it is the same thing again.

consults: the capabilities resolved for this team
the alert's source, severity and affected components
stages.name: plan_evidence
stages.summary: Scores the available capabilities against the alert and shortlists the ones worth starting from. Deterministic, so two runs of one scenario are comparable.

consults: every capability the catalogue allows, starting from the shortlist
the incident window, which clamps every time-bounded argument
the specialists this team declares, dispatched in parallel
stages.name: gather_evidence
stages.summary: The loop: calls capabilities, reads what comes back, and decides what to ask next, inside the iteration and tool ceilings.

stages.name: diagnose
stages.summary: One call scoped to the conclusion and the evidence, then every claim checked against the observations that back it.

consults: the destinations configured for this team
stages.name: deliver
stages.summary: Ships the finished report wherever the team is already looking, and records which destinations accepted it.
